BLB&B Advisors LLC grew its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.6% during the third its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 70,025 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 6,116 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for approximately 2.0% of BLB&B Advisors LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 9th largest holding. BLB&B Advisors LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $15,807,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
